data.name: Lost Relics
data.detailed_description:
Enter dangerous adventures. Risk what you carry. Escape with power… or leave it behind.

Two obstinate races, their intellects ascended yet unyielding, waged a war of unimaginable scale known as The Deception War. In its wake, entire civilizations were erased, leaving behind only fragments of their power, scattered and forgotten across the universe.

These remnants are now known as the Lost Relics.

Vanquish monsters and uncover some of the rarest Digital Collectibles in this Diablo-inspired action RPG, where every decision inside an adventure shapes what you keep… and what you lose.

Lost Relics is built around risk versus reward. Every expedition challenges you to push deeper for greater gains, while knowing that failure can cost you the items you carry and anything you find along the way. Survival means securing your rewards. Greed can cost you the run.

Delve into dangerous dungeons, battle relentless enemies, and gather powerful gear as you carve your path through a world driven by exploration, progression, and choice. Whether you are hunting for rare drops or crafting your next upgrade, every run presents meaningful decisions that define your outcome.

For those willing to take the risk, Digital Collectibles offer the rarest rewards. These items persist beyond individual adventures, allowing you to collect, trade, and build a legacy of truly scarce gear.

With deep progression systems, evolving content, and a world filled with secrets, Lost Relics rewards skill, strategy, and long-term mastery.

Key Features

  • Risk vs Reward Gameplay: Push deeper for better rewards, but risk the items you carry and everything you find along the way.

    Meaningful Progression: Level up your character, unlock powerful abilities, and refine your build across combat and gathering.

  • Dynamic Adventures: Explore handcrafted and procedurally driven environments filled with enemies, resources, and hidden opportunities.

  • Skill-Based Combat: Engage in real-time combat that rewards positioning, timing, and decision-making rather than button mashing.

  • Deep Itemization: Discover, craft, and upgrade a wide variety of weapons, and artifacts with unique effects and synergies.

  • Digital Collectibles: Find rare items that persist beyond individual adventures. Trade them, collect them, and build a legacy of truly scarce gear.

  • Living World: Interact with towns, NPCs, quests, and evolving systems that expand over time with new content and events.

  • Play Your Way: Focus on combat, gathering, crafting, or progression, and shape your own path through the world.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or later
  • Processor: Quad core 2.6GHz x64-compatible
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 650 Ti or ATI Radeon™ HD 7850
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Game is in heavy development, system requirements may change.
